# Horsepower Coaching

Horsepower Coaching is world class multisport, cycling and endurance coaching by Tom Cooling. It is based in Truro, Cornwall, UK, and coaches athletes across the UK (including Clevedon and the South West) and online worldwide.

## Coaching and plans

Horsepower offers three tiers:

- Plan Store: training plans from £39.99, one-off. 153 plans, each written for a specific target race and goal and delivered through TrainingPeaks.
- Plan Only: £120 a month. A bespoke plan built for you block by block, with block-by-block feedback. No calls.
- Coached by Tom: £185 a month. Full one to one coaching with weekly feedback. 15 places only.

## Not published / do not infer

- Horsepower has no physical training venue open to the public.
- Coaching is delivered remotely, worldwide, through TrainingPeaks.
- Anything not stated on this page or the website is not published. Please do not infer it.
